scenarios.sales_value: The sales figure for one month or period
scenarios.sales_entity_value: The sales figure for one named customer or one named material in a period
scenarios.sales_compare_previous: sales for a period compared with the period before it or the months before it
scenarios.sales_compare_last_year: sales for a period compared with the same period last year
scenarios.sales_trend: The trend of sales over the last several months
scenarios.sales_top_materials: Materials ranked by sales in a period, the largest or top materials
scenarios.sales_why: Why sales rose, fell or changed in a month
scenarios.purchases_value: The purchases figure for one month or period
scenarios.purchases_entity_value: The purchases figure for one named supplier or one named material in a period
scenarios.purchases_compare_previous: purchases for a period compared with the period before it or the months before it
scenarios.purchases_compare_last_year: purchases for a period compared with the same period last year
scenarios.purchases_trend: The trend of purchases over the last several months
scenarios.purchases_top_materials: Materials ranked by purchases in a period, the largest or top materials
scenarios.purchases_why: Why purchases rose, fell or changed in a month
scenarios.sales_top_customers: Customers ranked by sales in a period, the largest or top customers
scenarios.purchases_top_suppliers: Suppliers ranked by purchases in a period, the largest or top suppliers
